_howTo: Edit 'status' by hand when an event has clearly happened: 'now', 'watching', 'occurred' or 'future'. Nothing changes this automatically.

events.title: The signs of the last days
events.text: Wars, food shortages, pestilences, earthquakes and lawlessness, all together. "When you see all these things, know that he is near." (Matthew 24:33)

events.title: The kings give their power to the beast
events.wouldCount: Nations together handing their authority to one international power.
events.watching: International bodies gaining new powers, mandates or budgets.

events.title: "Peace and security!"
events.wouldCount: A notable, worldwide proclamation by the nations, not routine diplomatic wording.
events.watching: Summit declarations and joint statements. Each candidate is reviewed by hand.
events.note: Scripture ties it to sudden destruction but does not fix its exact place beside the next event.

events.title: The harlot is destroyed
events.wouldCount: The political powers turn on religion worldwide. The great tribulation begins.
events.watching: Government restrictions on religion, bans and seizures.
events.background: Pew Research: 58 countries had high or very high government restrictions on religion in 2023. Global median score rose from 1.8 (2007) to 3.0 (2021).

events.title: Gog of Magog attacks
events.wouldCount: Many nations come against a people living in peace, "without walls".
